label: Dry cooking batch weight vs OOSW
why: Abalone cooked for dry cooking cannot exceed the OOSW weight recorded for the job on REC 7.1.5 - a higher total means batches from different jobs got mixed. Only Cooking pot cards count; Blanching cards are ignored, so a pot that is blanched then cooked is counted once.
message: Cooking pot weight exceeding OOSW - possible batch mix
